prediction_text: Direction: Yes — Britain votes to leave the European Union in the referendum of 23 June 2016. The Leave side wins despite February polling showing 'Stay' ahead with many undecideds; the undecided bloc breaks toward Leave. Timing: decided on referendum day, 23 June 2016, with Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries on the day as the timing coordinate given in the card.
basis:
The card carries no tradition/system field; the item is a western mundane-astrology blog assessment, decided by that genre's method.

The large undecided bloc is the mechanism by which a February Stay lead fails to hold. Event-level claim: Leave wins the 23 June 2016 vote (single concrete item). No chart is fabricated beyond the configurations the card names. R80-REV1: binary outcome only, no margin claimed, not applicable.
